Attribute.Name: Translation Status
Attribute.ValueTemplate:
<derive expr="{
    ResultList:="",
    FrenchStatus:=valuelovid('PMDM.AT.TranslationStatusFrench'),
    GermanStatus:=valuelovid('PMDM.AT.TranslationStatusGerman'),
    FrenchValueTRANS:=concatenate("▪ ", iterate(stepurl2objid(stepurl("entity", "SysMsg_PMDM.AT.TranslationStatus_FR_msg1")), "value('PMDM.AT.SystemMessage')")),
    GermanValueTRANS:=concatenate("▪ ", iterate(stepurl2objid(stepurl("entity", "SysMsg_PMDM.AT.TranslationStatus_DE_msg1")), "value('PMDM.AT.SystemMessage')")),
    FrenchValueDONE:=concatenate("▪ ", iterate(stepurl2objid(stepurl("entity", "SysMsg_PMDM.AT.TranslationStatus_FR_msg3")), "value('PMDM.AT.SystemMessage')")),
    GermanValueDONE:=concatenate("▪ ", iterate(stepurl2objid(stepurl("entity", "SysMsg_PMDM.AT.TranslationStatus_DE_msg3")), "value('PMDM.AT.SystemMessage')")),
    FrenchValueNOT:=concatenate("▪ ", iterate(stepurl2objid(stepurl("entity", "SysMsg_PMDM.AT.TranslationStatus_FR_msg2")), "value('PMDM.AT.SystemMessage')")),
    GermanValueNOT:=concatenate("▪ ", iterate(stepurl2objid(stepurl("entity", "SysMsg_PMDM.AT.TranslationStatus_DE_msg2")), "value('PMDM.AT.SystemMessage')")),
    dummy:=concatenate(
        if(exact(FrenchStatus, "TRANS"),concatenate(ResultList:=listconcatenate(ResultList, FrenchValueTRANS)),""),
        if(exact(GermanStatus, "TRANS"),concatenate(ResultList:=listconcatenate(ResultList, GermanValueTRANS)),""),
        if(exact(FrenchStatus, "DONE"),concatenate(ResultList:=listconcatenate(ResultList, FrenchValueDONE)),""),
        if(exact(GermanStatus, "DONE"),concatenate(ResultList:=listconcatenate(ResultList, GermanValueDONE)),""),
        if(or(exact(FrenchStatus, ""), exact(FrenchStatus, "NOT")),concatenate(ResultList:=listconcatenate(ResultList, FrenchValueNOT)),""),
        if(or(exact(GermanStatus, ""), exact(GermanStatus, "NOT")),concatenate(ResultList:=listconcatenate(ResultList, GermanValueNOT)),"")
    )
}
list(ResultList, ", ")"/>
